data.name: PrivacyPolicy_PageTitle
data.value: Privacy Policy — CompanioNation™

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_MetaDescription
data.value: Privacy Policy and Terms of Service Agreement for CompanioNation™ — the first open-source dating app.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Heading
data.value: Privacy Policy and Terms of Service Agreement for CompanioNation™

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_EffectiveDate
data.value: Effective Date: February 18, 2026

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Intro
data.value: Welcome to CompanioNation™! We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy and Terms of Service Agreement ("Agreement") explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our services. By accessing or using CompanioNation™, you agree to the terms of this Agreement.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_InfoCollectHeading
data.value: 1. Information We Collect

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_InfoCollectIntro
data.value: We collect the following types of information:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_PersonalInfo
data.value: Personal Information: This includes your name, email address, date of birth, gender, and other information you provide during registration.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_UsageData
data.value: Usage Data: Information about your interactions with our website and services, such as IP address, browser type, device information, and browsing history.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_LocalStorage
data.value: Web Storage (LocalStorage): We use localStorage to store your preferences and settings locally on your device. This data helps us provide a more personalized and efficient experience. The information stored in localStorage is not shared with third parties.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ProfilePhotos
data.value: Profile Photos: When you upload a profile picture, we store the image as a standard image file and display it to other users according to your visibility settings.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_FaceDataHeading
data.value: 2. Profile Photos and Face Data

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_FaceData1
data.value: To keep our community safe, when you upload a profile picture our automated system briefly analyzes the image only to confirm that a human face is present and visible (for example, to reject photos that show no person, multiple people, or prohibited content). This is face detection — determining whether a face appears in the image. It is not facial recognition, and we do not create, extract, use, store, or share any faceprint, facial geometry, biometric template, or other biometric identifier from your photos, and we do not use your photo to identify you.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_FaceData2
data.value: The detection check is momentary and performed at upload time. No biometric or face-geometry data is generated or retained as a result of it. We retain only the profile image file itself, which we treat as ordinary user-provided content subject to the retention and deletion terms in this Agreement (see "Retention of Personal Information" below). Your profile photo is shown to other users based on your chosen visibility settings.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_FaceDataSharing
data.value: Sharing: We do not sell or share your photos or any face data with third parties for their own purposes. Profile images are hosted using standard cloud storage infrastructure that operates on our behalf and under our instructions. No facial recognition or biometric data is ever shared with third parties, because none is created.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_UseHeading
data.value: 3. How We Use Your Information

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_UseIntro
data.value: We use your information for the following purposes:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Use1
data.value: To provide, maintain, and improve our services.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Use2
data.value: To personalize your experience and provide tailored recommendations.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Use3
data.value: To communicate with you, including sending updates, notifications, and promotional materials.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Use4
data.value: To ensure the security and integrity of our services.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Use5
data.value: To comply with legal obligations and enforce our terms.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Use6
data.value: To protect your safety and prevent fraudulent activities.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_DisclosureHeading
data.value: 4. Disclosure of Your Information

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_DisclosureIntro
data.value: We may disclose your information in the following circumstances:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Disclosure1
data.value: With Your Consent: We may share your information with third parties if you provide us with explicit consent to do so.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Disclosure2
data.value: Service Providers: We may share your information with third-party service providers who perform services on our behalf.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Disclosure3
data.value: Legal Obligations: We may disclose your information to law enforcement, government authorities, or other legitimate third parties when required by law or when we believe such disclosure is necessary to comply with legal processes, protect our rights, or prevent harm.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_SecurityHeading
data.value: 5. Data Security

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_SecurityBody
data.value: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration, and destruction. However, no security measures are completely foolproof, and we cannot guarantee the absolute security of your data.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_RightsHeading
data.value: 6. Your Rights

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_RightsIntro
data.value: Under PIPEDA and PIPA, you have the right to:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Rights1
data.value: Access and update your personal information.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Rights2
data.value: Request the deletion of your data.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Rights3
data.value: Object to the processing of your data.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Rights4
data.value: Withdraw your consent at any time.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_RightsExercise
data.value: To exercise these rights, please follow the procedures outlined below.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_RetentionHeading
data.value: 7. Retention of Personal Information

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_RetentionBody
data.value: We will retain your personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by law. When your personal information is no longer needed, we will securely destroy or anonymize it.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_DeletionRequests
data.value: Deletion Requests: If you wish to delete your personal information, you can request this by submitting a written request via one of the following methods:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_DeletionMail
data.value: Mail: Send a written request to us at the address provided below. Please include sufficient information to verify the legitimacy of your request, such as your full name, email address associated with your account, and any other relevant details.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ProcessingDeletion
data.value: Processing Deletion Requests: Upon receiving a deletion request, we will:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Processing1
data.value: Verify your identity to ensure the legitimacy of the request.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Processing2
data.value: Assess the request to determine if any legal obligations require us to retain certain information.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Processing3
data.value: Allocate a processing period of up to 60 days to ensure there are no pending legal obligations or investigations that necessitate retaining your information.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Processing4
data.value: If retention is necessary, we will inform you of the reasons and the extent of data that cannot be deleted.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Processing5
data.value: Proceed with deletion of all other personal information that is not subject to legal retention.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Respond60
data.value: We strive to respond to all deletion requests within 60 days of receipt. If additional time is needed, we will inform you accordingly.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_MailVerificationNote
data.value: By requiring deletion requests to be submitted via mail, we ensure that all requests are thoroughly verified, thereby maintaining the integrity and security of our platform. This approach helps prevent unauthorized or malicious attempts to delete information, contributing to the overall safety of our community.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_LiabilityHeading
data.value: 8. Limitation of Liability

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_LiabilityIntro
data.value: To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, CompanioNation™ shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages, including without limitation, loss of profits, data, use, goodwill, or other intangible losses, resulting from:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Liability1
data.value: your access to or use of or inability to access or use our services;

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Liability2
data.value: any conduct or content of any third party on our services, including without limitation, any defamatory, offensive, or illegal conduct of other users or third parties;

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Liability3
data.value: any content obtained from our services;

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Liability4
data.value: unauthorized access, use, or alteration of your transmissions or content.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_LiabilityCap
data.value: In no event shall CompanioNation™'s total liability to you for all damages, losses, and causes of action exceed the amount you have paid us, if any, in the past twelve (12) months.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ChangesHeading
data.value: 9. Changes to This Agreement

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ChangesBody
data.value: We may update this Agreement from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. We will notify you of any significant changes by posting the new Agreement on our website and updating the effective date.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ContactHeading
data.value: 10. Contact Us

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ContactIntro
data.value: If you have any questions or concerns about this Agreement, please contact us at:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_EmailLabel
data.value: Email:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_PhoneLabel
data.value: Phone:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ComplianceHeading
data.value: 11. Compliance with Legal Obligations

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ComplianceIntro
data.value: We may retain and disclose your personal information as required by law, regulation, or legal process. This includes situations where we believe that retaining your information is necessary to:

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Compliance1
data.value: Comply with a legal obligation.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Compliance2
data.value: Protect and defend our rights or property.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Compliance3
data.value: Prevent or investigate possible wrongdoing in connection with our services.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Compliance4
data.value: Protect the personal safety of users of our services or the public.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ComplianceRetain
data.value: In such cases, even if you have requested deletion of your personal information, we may retain certain data to comply with these obligations.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_Acknowledge
data.value: By using CompanioNation™, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Privacy Policy and Terms of Service Agreement and agree to be bound by its terms.

data.name: PrivacyPolicy_ProfileVisibilityNote
data.value: Profile Visibility: For safety reasons, we strongly encourage users to disable the visibility of their profiles instead of deleting their accounts. Disabling visibility allows us to maintain necessary records while protecting your privacy and enhancing the security of our community.
